name: jetcompact
description: JetCompact: verbatim Claude Code compaction guided by a fast decision model (Jev or OpenAI Decisions), with a recall tool that reads back what compaction cut and searches past sessions.

provider.title: Decision provider
provider.description: jev (TypeSafe Jev, default), openai (OpenAI Decisions API, gpt-6-luna; key from OPENAI_API_KEY), or algorithmic (no decision model: keeps the newest tool output, errors and edits within the same budgets; needs no key and makes no request).

apiKey.title: Jev API key
apiKey.description: TypeSafe (or OpenRouter) key for provider jev. Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_API_KEY or envFile. Ignored with provider openai, which reads OPENAI_API_KEY.

baseUrl.title: Jev endpoint
baseUrl.description: Endpoint the Jev call goes to. Leave unset for the TypeSafe one; set it to https://openrouter.ai/api/alpha/decisions to reach the same model through OpenRouter. Ignored with provider openai.

envFile.title: Key file
envFile.description: Path to a dotenv-style file to read the key from when neither the environment nor the settings hold one. An absolute path, or one under the session's working directory.

keepMode.title: Keep mode
keepMode.description: rank keeps the best-scored tool calls within the token budgets below (Jev scores are compressed, so an absolute threshold keeps almost nothing); threshold applies the keep threshold.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Threshold mode only: minimum Jev probability that a tool call or tool result is still needed; below it the item is removed.

keepResultTokens.title: Kept result tokens
keepResultTokens.description: Rank mode: estimated tokens of tool results kept verbatim, best-scored first.

keepCallTokens.title: Kept call tokens
keepCallTokens.description: Rank mode: estimated tokens of tool inputs (with a truncated result head) kept for calls whose full result is dropped.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction, of the window Claude Code compacts at (CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW when set).

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history.

recall.title: Recall tool
recall.description: Offer the model a recall tool that searches the session transcript and reads back what compaction cut. It runs on a pinned Node that tools/node.cmd downloads on first use.

sessionIndex.title: Session index
sessionIndex.description: auto: when qmd is installed, recall's search across past sessions uses a qmd index of them (markdown copies under <config dir>/jetcompact/sessions/, a qmd index named jetcompact-sessions); off: it always scans the transcripts.

dropCalls.title: Drop whole tool calls
dropCalls.description: When Jev rates a call as no longer needed, remove the call and its result. Off: keep the call and truncate only its result, so the history still shows a tool call before every report.

compactionTimeoutMs.title: Jev compaction timeout
compactionTimeoutMs.description: Maximum milliseconds to wait for a Jev round, including all request batches. A timed-out plugin request leaves history unchanged; other compactions follow builtinFallback.

builtinFallback.title: Built-in summary fallback
builtinFallback.description: Which compactions fall back to Claude Code's built-in summary when Jev fails or frees less than the minimum: auto (only Claude Code's own automatic compaction; others leave the conversation as it is), always, or never.

targetPercent.title: Target context percentage
targetPercent.description: Falls back to the built-in summary when the estimated context after compaction would still exceed this percentage of the window.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Jev state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every Jev request.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum Jev request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one Jev request.

maxConcurrentRequests.title: Concurrent Jev requests
maxConcurrentRequests.description: Jev requests in flight at once during one compaction.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when Jev decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note. Unset: 300, or 100 once old prose is digested.

trimHostText.title: Trim host notices
trimHostText.description: Cut system reminders, task notifications, command echoes and hook output (never the user's own prose) outside the newest messages to a short head and a marker.

hostTextHeadChars.title: Trimmed host notice head
hostTextHeadChars.description: Characters of a trimmed host notice kept before its marker; 0 keeps only the marker.

taskResultHeadChars.title: Kept subagent report
taskResultHeadChars.description: Characters of a task notification's result (a subagent's final report) kept when trimming host notices; 0 trims it like any other notice.

oldProse.title: Old prose
oldProse.description: What becomes of user and assistant prose older than the last `recentTurns` user turns: `keep` (verbatim), `digest` (deterministic extractive digest) or `summarize` (summary written by `proseModel`, falling back to the digest). Unset: verbatim while that frees enough; the digest once verbatim prose would leave the compaction refused, and while that digest stays in the conversation.

recentTurns.title: Recent turns
recentTurns.description: User turns kept outside the `oldProse` digest or summary.

proseModel.title: Summary model
proseModel.description: Model alias or id that writes the summary when `oldProse` is `summarize`, through the session's own client.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model name for the provider; with provider openai a jev name is replaced by gpt-6-luna.

ageCutResults.title: Age cut results
ageCutResults.description: A tool result an earlier compaction already cut to a head loses that head at the next compaction: only its cut note stays, and recall returns the full text. Pinned results are never aged.

questionCriteria.title: Question criteria
questionCriteria.description: Give each decision-model question true/false criteria describing what a tool call or result worth keeping looks like (changes made, errors still being diagnosed) and what is safe to cut (superseded reads, passing runs).
